image_description: Three vintage comic books arranged on a red and white checkered tablecloth. The top left comic is 'The Mighty Thor' featuring a character in a winged helmet. The bottom left is 'Tales to Astonish' showing a green-skinned giant (Hulk). The center/right comic is 'Creatures on the Loose' featuring a werewolf-like creature. All covers display bold title typography, illustrated artwork, and price boxes.

artifact_observations.location: Title of the top-left comic ('The Mighty Thor')
artifact_observations.reasoning: The title text is heavily distorted. While it mimics the shape of 'THOR', the letters are melted and illegible, failing to render coherent characters. This is a common AI failure mode for specific brand typography.

artifact_observations.location: Subtitle/Tagline text on all three covers
artifact_observations.reasoning: Smaller text blocks (e.g., 'Featuring...', price boxes) contain pseudo-text that resembles English letterforms but collapses into gibberish upon close inspection.
The red dots on the white cloth show slight irregularities in spacing and shape consistency, suggesting minor generative noise rather than a perfect geometric print.
